goodToKnow: Der Mittelstand means Germany's small and medium-sized businesses, often family-owned for generations, and is called the backbone of the economy. Many are hidden champions: little-known firms in small towns that lead world markets in niches like industrial screws or organ pipes. Mittelständisch means medium-sized: ein mittelständisches Unternehmen. Historically, der Mittelstand also meant the middle class. It has no plural.
